listing.name: Azure Dreams (Azure Dreams HD Recompilation)
listing.summary: An Azure Dreams port with a recompiled base game and interpreted overlays unless you separately compile them with compile_overlays.py --static. A release ZIP alone does not establish fully static coverage or a full playthrough. The Windows 10 player/source route downloads its framework toolchain, generates base C from your own USA SLUS-00614 PlayStation disc and rebuilds locally. OpenBIOS is bundled. Other player platforms, exact accepted revision/hashes and further BIOS/firmware requirements are unconfirmed. You and the project manage generated files and updates; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
